scripts.build: node src/scripts/run-scheduled-publish.mjs && node src/scripts/lint-duplicate-titles.mjs && node src/scripts/lint-missing-images.mjs && node src/scripts/seo-lint-fixer.mjs && node research/agents/lib/generate-llms-txt.mjs && astro build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/sitemap-0.xml')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/sitemap-0.xml', 'dist/sitemap.xml');" && node research/agents/lib/inline-css.mjs && npx pagefind --site dist && node scratch/trigger_indexnow.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && git add src/content/articles/ src/content/categories/ public/images/ public/downloads/ public/robots.txt public/.well-known/ public/_redirects astro.config.mjs vercel.json src/content.config.ts src/components/ src/pages/ src/scripts/ src/styles/ src/middleware.ts src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro .github/workflows/ci-build-audit.yml src/scripts/publish_schedule.json docs/ syndication/ open-source/ package.json package-lock.json .gitignore scripts/scoutdb.mjs src/lib/seo/metadata.ts && git commit -m "publish: deploy articles and assets [auto]" && git push origin main
scripts.validate-content: node src/scripts/lint-duplicate-titles.mjs && node src/scripts/lint-missing-images.mjs && astro check
